topic: User profile authentication and switching logic
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on updating the user profile authentication view and implementing logic for switching between multiple profiles. It was decided that when a profile is changed, the current profile should be updated rather than creating a new one.

Regarding client-side data structure for profiles upon login, the preference leaned towards returning an array of strings (e.g., `profiles:['default/main', 'planner']`) if names are included, although this requires making the name field mandatory or at least suggesting it as default.

It was determined that a dedicated method is required for profile switching, separate from the main login and refresh token methods, to handle minimal changes across the server.
decisions: When changing a user profile, the current profile should be updated (modified) rather than creating a new one.
A dedicated method must be implemented for profile switching functionality.
action_items: Implement changes to the user profile authentication view using the provided SQL structure.
Develop logic to handle displaying and selecting profiles on the UI, ensuring minimal disruption to existing server functions.
